finding.summary: The phase-one reference is only checked for being a JSON object before route validation is skipped when the keyring has any shape error. Thus a malformed phase-one receipt (for example `{"kind":"not-a-route"}`) plus a malformed keyring reports only the keyring violation; the phase receipt’s independently checkable form is hidden until a later run, contrary to the declared per-route-reference aggregation guarantee.
